# What kala checks

When you ask kala to check your code, these are the rules it runs. Everything here is
deterministic — no model judgement, no API call.

kala never guesses. If it cannot resolve a style statically (a dynamic class expression, a
CSS rule that depends on ancestors), it reports that as *not analysed* rather than inventing
a finding. That is why a check that finds nothing is meaningful.

---

## Source rules (13)

These run on your files. Say: *"Check src/Settings.tsx against our design system"*.

<!-- kala:docs:rules:start — generated by scripts/build-docs.mjs, do not edit -->
| Rule | Severity | Scope | What it catches |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color-off-palette` | error | node | Color {value} is not in the project palette. |
| `flat-type-hierarchy` | warn | aggregate | Only {distinct} distinct text sizes on this surface. Hierarchy is flat. |
| `list-without-empty` | warn | document | A list is rendered with no empty case. |
| `missing-empty-state` | error | document | This surface fetches a list and renders it, but has no empty state. |
| `missing-error-state` | error | document | A data source has no error branch. |
| `missing-loading-state` | warn | document | A data source has no loading branch. |
| `monotonous-spacing` | info | aggregate | Every element uses the same padding. Spacing carries no rhythm. |
| `nested-card` | warn | node | A bordered, rounded container sits directly inside another one. |
| `radius-off-scale` | warn | node | Border radius {value} is not on the project radius scale. |
| `space-off-scale` | error | node | Padding {value} is not on the project spacing scale. |
| `text-contrast` | error | relation | Text contrast is below the 4.5:1 WCAG 2.1 AA minimum. |
| `tiny-text` | warn | node | Text size {value} is below the 12px legibility floor. |
| `type-off-scale` | error | node | Text size {value} is not on the project type scale. |
<!-- kala:docs:rules:end -->

**Severity:** fix every `error`. Fix `warn` unless it conflicts with something you asked for
deliberately. `info` is an observation.

---

## Rendered checks (3)

These need a running page, because no amount of source reading can answer them. Say:
*"Review localhost:5173/settings"*.

| Check | Severity | What it catches |
|---|---|---|
| `computed-contrast` | error | Real contrast against whatever background actually renders behind the text, including inherited and layered backgrounds. Large text is held to 3:1 rather than 4.5:1. |
| `horizontal-overflow` | error | The page scrolls sideways at a real viewport width, naming the widest element responsible. |
| `small-touch-target` | warn | Interactive elements under 44px at viewports of 1024px and below. Zero-sized elements are skipped as hidden rather than small. |

A fourth result, `contrast-unresolved`, is reported at `info` when no opaque background can
be found — over an image, for example. kala says it could not judge rather than inventing a
ratio.

The rendered checks need Chromium, which is opt-in:

```bash
npx playwright install chromium
```

Without it, everything else works unchanged and the review tells you what to install.

---

## Anti-patterns the systems ban (24)

Each design system refuses specific patterns. When your project uses a system, its bans
become part of every brief and guide response kala returns.

<!-- kala:docs:anti-patterns:start — generated by scripts/build-docs.mjs, do not edit -->
| Pattern | Banned by |
|---|---|
| `all-caps-labels` | `playful-rounded`, `warm-utility` |
| `animated-counters` | `dense-console` |
| `card-grid-everything` | `archive-serif`, `editorial-clean` |
| `card-in-card` | `dense-console`, `quiet-precision` |
| `carousel-hero` | `bold-commerce` |
| `countdown-timers` | `soft-clinical` |
| `dark-patterns` | `soft-clinical` |
| `dense-data-grid` | `playful-rounded`, `sunlit-wellness`, `warm-utility` |
| `drop-shadows` | `archive-serif`, `editorial-clean`, `stark-brutal` |
| `fake-countdown` | `bold-commerce` |
| `gradient-anything` | `muted-enterprise`, `quiet-precision`, `stark-brutal`, `technical-mono` |
| `gray-on-color` | `bold-commerce` |
| `hover-only-actions` | `muted-enterprise` |
| `hover-reveal-actions` | `dense-console` |
| `illustration-empty-states` | `technical-mono` |
| `infinite-scroll` | `archive-serif` |
| `placeholder-as-label` | `muted-enterprise` |
| `pure-gray-neutrals` | `warm-utility` |
| `red-error-states` | `sunlit-wellness` |
| `rounded-corners` | `editorial-clean`, `stark-brutal` |
| `rounded-pill-buttons` | `technical-mono` |
| `shadow-on-rest-state` | `quiet-precision` |
| `tiny-tap-targets` | `playful-rounded` |
| `urgency-banners` | `soft-clinical`, `sunlit-wellness` |
<!-- kala:docs:anti-patterns:end -->
